## Evidence

- [ ] Artifact URLs are immutable HTTPS locations.
- [ ] Byte lengths and SHA-256 digests were recomputed from downloaded bytes.
- [ ] Install, startup, shutdown, update, rollback, and uninstall were tested.
- [ ] `runtime_kind` is `cordis` and `load.entry_points` match the wheel's
      `liteyukibot.cordis_plugins` entry points.
- [ ] Requested capabilities and platform restrictions are complete.
- [ ] The publisher provides a private security-reporting path.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_index.py index.json` passes.
